dashboard.name: A - Vue générale de l'hôpital
dashboard.description: Vue générale: admissions, sorties, lits, capacité, taux d'occupation, dépenses, énergie, évolution temporelle et aperçu des risques.

cards.name: Admissions - série temporelle
cards.query: SELECT day, admissions_total FROM vw_kpi_daily ORDER BY day;
cards.notes: Filtre période à configurer dans Metabase (Date Range filter sur 'day').

cards.name: Sorties - série temporelle
cards.query: SELECT day, discharges_total FROM vw_kpi_daily ORDER BY day;

cards.name: Occupation vs Capacité - série temporelle
cards.query: SELECT day, occupied_beds_total, capacity_total, occupancy_rate FROM vw_kpi_daily ORDER BY day;

cards.name: Dépenses et consommation énergétique
cards.query: SELECT day, expenses_total, energy_total FROM vw_kpi_daily ORDER BY day;

cards.name: Résumé par service (dernier jour)
cards.query: SELECT date, service_name, admissions, discharges, occupied_beds, beds_total, occupancy_rate, expenses, energy_kwh FROM vw_service_summary WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM vw_kpi_daily) ORDER BY service_name;

cards.name: Aperçu des risques / recommandations
cards.query: SELECT service_name, severity, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM vw_recommendations GROUP BY service_name, severity ORDER BY cnt DESC;
cards.notes: Si aucune recommandation n'est présente, ce panneau restera vide.
